title: Chapter 1: Fernhollow
_comment: Chapter 1 remodel (2026-09-10, v3): map tripled in each dimension (was 50x26). The old single Hollowbrook Maze is now three sequential maze segments (Hollowbrook Thicket, the Boulder Maze, the Bramblegate), each fully sealed on its own (spans the full playable height, same anti-bypass fix as v2) and built from a different, still-coherent prop set, connected by open populated chambers. Layout: village (cols 2-27), Segment A/tree maze (29-54), Chamber A - hostage + hostiles (55-64), Segment B/boulder maze (65-90), Chamber B - more hostiles (91-100), Segment C/bramble maze (101-126), the wood + pond beyond (128-148).
